title: एकविंशतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The woman gives the sage oil and a bathing cloth, and in the night offers herself, saying that she is free to do so and that the wrong of it may fall on her. Ashtavakra, steady in his self-restraint, refuses to rise from his vow and says that he cannot do what is contrary to it.
summary.kn: ಆ ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಋಷಿಗೆ ಎಣ್ಣೆ, ಸ್ನಾನವಸ್ತ್ರ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ರಾತ್ರಿ ತನ್ನನ್ನೇ ಅರ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ನಾನು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರಳು, ಅಧರ್ಮ ನನ್ನ ಮೇಲಿರಲಿ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಾವಕ್ರ ಸಂಯಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರನಾಗಿ ವ್ರತದಿಂದ ಏಳಲಾರೆ, ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಮಾಡಲಾರೆನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: वह स्त्री ऋषि को तेल और स्नान-वस्त्र देती है और रात में स्वयं को अर्पित करती है, कहती है कि वह स्वतन्त्र है और दोष उसी पर पड़े। अष्टावक्र संयम में स्थिर रहकर कहते हैं कि वे व्रत से नहीं डिगेंगे और उसके विरुद्ध नहीं कर सकते।
summary.te: ఆ స్త్రీ ఋషికి నూనె, స్నాన వస్త్రం ఇచ్చి రాత్రి తనను తానే అర్పించుకుంటూ తాను స్వతంత్రనని, అధర్మం తనపై పడనీ అంటుంది. అష్టావక్రుడు సంయమంలో స్థిరంగా వ్రతం నుండి లేవనని, దానికి విరుద్ధంగా చేయలేనని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: அப்பெண் முனிவருக்கு எண்ணெயும் குளியல் ஆடையும் தந்து இரவில் தன்னையே அளிக்கிறாள், நான் சுதந்திரமானவள், பழி என்மீது இருக்கட்டும் என்கிறாள். அஷ்டாவக்கிரர் அடக்கத்தில் உறுதியாக நின்று விரதத்திலிருந்து எழமாட்டேன், அதற்கு மாறாகச் செய்ய இயலாது என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: വൃദ്ധ മുനിക്ക് എണ്ണയും കുളിക്കാനുള്ള വസ്ത്രവും നൽകുന്നു; രാത്രിയിൽ താൻ അതിന് സ്വതന്ത്രയാണെന്നും, അതിന്റെ തെറ്റ് തന്റെമേൽ വന്നുകൊള്ളട്ടെ എന്നും പറഞ്ഞ് അവൾ തന്നെത്തന്നെ അർപ്പിക്കുന്നു. ആത്മനിയന്ത്രണത്തിൽ ഉറച്ചുനിൽക്കുന്ന അഷ്ടാവക്രൻ തന്റെ വ്രതത്തിൽനിന്ന് മാറാൻ വിസമ്മതിക്കുന്നു; വ്രതത്തിന് വിരുദ്ധമായത് ചെയ്യാനാവില്ലെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.21; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अथ सा स्त्री तमुक्त्वा तु विप्रमेवं भवत्विति ।
तैलं दिव्यमुपादाय स्नानशाटीमुपानयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the woman said to the brahmin, 'So be it,' and taking divine oil, she brought a bathing cloth.

verses.text:
अनुज्ञाता च मुनिना सा स्त्री तेन महात्मना ।
अथास्य तैलेनाङ्गानि सर्वाण्येवाभ्यमृक्षयत् ॥

meaning.en: Permitted by that great-souled sage, she then anointed all his limbs with the oil.

verses.text:
शनैश्चोत्सादितस्तत्र स्नानशालामुपागमत् ।
भद्रासनं ततश्चित्रं ऋषिरन्वाविशन्नवम् ॥

meaning.en: Slowly rubbed down, he went to the bathing hall, and there the sage took his place on a fresh and beautiful auspicious seat.

verses.text:
अथोपविष्टश्च यदा तस्मिन्भद्रासने तदा ।
स्नापयामास शनकैस्तमृषिं सुखहस्तवत् ।
दिव्यं च विधिवच्चक्रे सोपचारं मुनेस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: When he was seated on that seat, she bathed the sage gently with hands that gave pleasure, and carried out the divine service for him properly with every attention.

verses.text:
स तेन सुसुखोष्णेन तस्या हस्तसुखेन च ।
व्यतीतां रजनीं कृत्स्नां नाजानात्स महाव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: By that pleasantly warm bath and the pleasure of her hands, that sage of great vows did not notice the whole night pass.

verses.text:
तत उत्थाय स मुनिस्तदा परमविस्मितः ।
पूर्वस्यां दिशि सूर्यं च सोऽपश्यदुदितं दिवि ॥

meaning.en: Then the sage rose, greatly amazed, and saw the sun risen in the sky in the east.

verses.text:
तस्य बुद्धिरियं किं नु मोहस्तत्त्वमिदं भवेत् ।
अथोपास्य सहस्रांशुं किं करोमीत्युवाच ताम् ॥

meaning.en: He thought, 'What is this? Is it delusion, or is it real?' Then, having worshipped the thousand-rayed sun, he asked her, 'What shall I do?'

verses.text:
सा चामृतरसप्रख्यमृषेरन्नमुपाहरत् ।
तस्य स्वादुतयान्नस्य न प्रभूतं चकार सः ।
व्यगमच्चाप्यहःशेषं ततः संध्यागमत्पुनः ॥

meaning.en: She brought the sage food that tasted like nectar. Because of its sweetness he did not eat much, and the rest of the day passed, and evening came again.

verses.text:
अथ स्त्री भगवन्तं सा सुप्यतामित्यचोदयत् ।
तत्र वै शयने दिव्ये तस्य तस्याश्च कल्पिते ॥

meaning.en: Then the woman urged the blessed sage, 'Please sleep,' on a divine bed prepared there for him and for her.

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
न भद्रे परदारेषु मनो मे संप्रसज्जति ।
उत्तिष्ठ भद्रे भद्रं ते स्वप वै विरमस्व च ॥

meaning.en: Good lady, my mind is not drawn to another man's wife. Rise, good lady, and may you be well; sleep and leave off.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
सा तदा तेन विप्रेण तथा धृत्या निवर्तिता ।
स्वतन्त्रास्मीत्युवाचैनं न धर्मच्छलमस्ति ते ॥

meaning.en: Turned away then by that brahmin's firmness, she said to him, 'I am free; there is no trick of dharma in this for you.'

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
नास्ति स्वतन्त्रता स्त्रीणामस्वतन्त्रा हि योषितः ।
प्रजापतिमतं ह्येतन्न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Women have no independence; women are dependent. This is the view of Prajapati; a woman does not deserve independence.

verses.text: स्त्र्युवाच

meaning.en: The woman said:

verses.text:
बाधते मैथुनं विप्र मम भक्तिं च पश्य वै ।
अधर्मं प्राप्स्यसे विप्र यन्मां त्वं नाभिनन्दसि ॥

meaning.en: Desire torments me, brahmin, and see my devotion. You will incur adharma, brahmin, in not welcoming me.

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
हरन्ति दोषजातानि नरं जातं यथेच्छकम् ।
प्रभवामि सदा धृत्या भद्रे स्वं शयनं व्रज ॥

meaning.en: Faults take hold of a man who lives as he pleases. I always rule myself by steadiness, good lady; go to your own bed.

verses.text: स्त्र्युवाच

meaning.en: The woman said:

verses.text:
शिरसा प्रणमे विप्र प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।
भूमौ निपतमानायाः शरणं भव मेऽनघ ॥

meaning.en: I bow my head, brahmin; you should show me favor. Be a refuge, sinless one, for me who am falling to the ground.

verses.text:
यदि वा दोषजातं त्वं परदारेषु पश्यसि ।
आत्मानं स्पर्शयाम्यद्य पाणिं गृह्णीष्व मे द्विज ॥

meaning.en: Or if you see fault in touching another man's wife, today I give myself to you; take my hand, brahmin.

verses.text:
न दोषो भविता चैव सत्येनैतद्ब्रवीम्यहम् ।
स्वतन्त्रां मां विजानीहि योऽधर्मः सोऽस्तु वै मयि ॥

meaning.en: There will be no fault. I say this in truth. Know me to be free, and let whatever adharma there is fall on me.

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
स्वतन्त्रा त्वं कथं भद्रे ब्रूहि कारणमत्र वै ।
नास्ति लोके हि काचित्स्त्री या वै स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: How are you free, good lady? Tell me the reason here. There is no woman in the world who deserves independence.

verses.text:
पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने ।
पुत्राश्च स्थविरीभावे न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: A father protects her in childhood, a husband in youth, and sons in old age; a woman does not deserve independence.

verses.text: स्त्र्युवाच

meaning.en: The woman said:

verses.text:
कौमारं ब्रह्मचर्यं मे कन्यैवास्मि न संशयः ।
कुरु मा विमतिं विप्र श्रद्धां विजहि मा मम ॥

meaning.en: I have kept the vow of celibacy from girlhood; I am a maiden, without doubt. Do not doubt me, brahmin; do not destroy my faith.

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
यथा मम तथा तुभ्यं यथा तव तथा मम ।
जिज्ञासेयमृषेस्तस्य विघ्नः सत्यं नु किं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: As it is for me, so it is for you; as it is for you, so it is for me. This is that sage's test; what could the obstacle be, and what is true?

verses.text:
आश्चर्यं परमं हीदं किं नु श्रेयो हि मे भवेत् ।
दिव्याभरणवस्त्रा हि कन्येयं मामुपस्थिता ॥

meaning.en: This is a great wonder; what would be best for me? This maiden has come to me in divine ornaments and clothes.

verses.text:
किं त्वस्याः परमं रूपं जीर्णमासीत्कथं पुनः ।
कन्यारूपमिहाद्यैव किमिहात्रोत्तरं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: But how could her supreme beauty have become old, and now be a maiden's form today? What is the answer here?

verses.text:
यथा परं शक्तिधृतेर्न व्युत्थास्ये कथंचन ।
न रोचये हि व्युत्थानं धृत्यैवं साधयाम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: So I will not in any way break my steadiness. I do not wish to break it; thus I accomplish the aim by steadiness.
